title: Trump Flaunts Camaraderie With Xi and Putin but Has Little to Show for It
summary: President Trump called Russia’s leader his “friend” and marveled at China’s warm welcome for his first-ever trilateral summit. But there were no breakthroughs on nuclear control, the war in Ukraine or A.I.
